items.headline: Russian Drone Strikes Ukraine's Security Headquarters Ahead of Peace Talks
items.summary: A Russian drone struck the central Kyiv headquarters of Ukraine's Security Service on Friday, injuring several people in a direct hit on a major government facility. Ukrainian officials described the strike as a major escalation that occurred just as diplomatic discussions with U.S. representatives were set to begin.

items.headline: Google Issues Emergency Security Patch for Actively Exploited Chrome Zero-Day Vulnerability
items.summary: Google has released an emergency security update for its Chrome browser to address a high-severity zero-day flaw in its V8 JavaScript engine. Tracked as CVE-2026-85046, the vulnerability is already being actively exploited in real-world attacks, prompting security experts to advise immediate browser updates.

items.headline: Top Seed Alexander Zverev Survives Another Five-Set Marathon at US Open
items.summary: Top-seeded Alexander Zverev defeated Quentin Halys in a four-hour and 33-minute epic to advance to the third round of the 2026 US Open. The hard-fought victory marked Zverev's second consecutive five-set thriller in New York, bringing his total court time to over nine hours across his first two matches.

items.headline: George Clooney Honored with Golden Lion Lifetime Achievement Award at Venice Film Festival
items.summary: Oscar-winning actor and filmmaker George Clooney was awarded the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the opening of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival in Italy. Presented by actress Laura Dern, the prestigious award celebrates Clooney's four-decade career as an actor, director, and producer in global cinema.
